name: Baladan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Berodach-baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sends letters and a present to Hezekiah, having heard he had been sick; this is the introduction of Babylon, still only a province under Assyria at this time.

note.label: 2 Kings 20: Hezekiah's Healing and His Folly

points: Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, having heard he had been sick and recovered. Hezekiah was glad of them and showed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, the gold, the spices, the ointment, and all his armor, holding nothing back in all his dominion.

note.label: Isaiah 39: The Treasures Shown and Babylon Foretold
